gaps: No official endpoint supplies a causal mapping from a game judgment to a puzzle theme; the training brief must keep both evidence streams distinct.
The official API includes Board and Bot play operations, but they are deliberately out of scope to protect fair play.
patterns: Bound game exports and serialize requests under the official rate guidance.
Use only completed games for analysis and retain Lichess-provided judgments instead of adding engine calculations.
Keep all external writes explicit and token-scoped.

novel_features.name: Ten-minute named challenge
novel_features.description: Create an explicit 10+0 Lichess challenge for a named player only after --send is supplied.
novel_features.rationale: Maps a high-frequency personal workflow to official least-privilege challenge creation.

novel_features.name: Bounded recurring-loss report
novel_features.description: Mechanically group official completed-game judgments by opening, performance, and phase.
novel_features.rationale: Makes existing Lichess analysis useful across a bounded history without live-game or engine assistance.

novel_features.name: Evidence-separated training brief
novel_features.description: Combine official puzzle-theme performance with local loss-pattern evidence while preserving the absence of a causal mapping.
novel_features.rationale: Turns two official evidence streams into a safe, concrete practice choice.
